title: Cute But Arrived Damaged
text: Cute But Arrived Damaged. Really cute but arrived with the paint all chipped off on the hook. So instead of blue, it is a shiny silver. Not a good look, so will be returning to sender.  Disappointed because I really liked them for my beach themed bathroom.
